div.head: Wi 4.1
div.ab: swæse mæn in leodum ciriclicæs gemanan ungestrodyne þoligen.
swæse mæn in leodum ciriclicæs gemanan ungestrodyne þoligen.
Swæse mæn in leodum ciriclicæs gemanan ungestrodyne þoligen.
heimische Männer im Volke kirchlicher Gemeinschaft verlustig gehen, [jedoch] ungepfändet.
native men among the people are to lose the communion of the Church, [but] without their goods being distrained.
Men of our own country also shall be excluded from the communion of the Church, without being subject to forfeiture of their goods.
Our own men, in this people, are to forfeit the fellowship of the Church, without confiscating their goods.
Our own men among the people [i.e., native] shall suffer loss of the community of the church without forfeiture of goods.

note.seg: ‘Stammverwandte, eingeborene’, nicht ‘inland strangers’; zu leodum vgl. Abt 2¹
‘Of the same stock, native-born’, not ‘inland strangers’; on leodum cf. Abt 2¹
Wie Wi 3. Vgl. Gl Exkommunikation 8a. b. 11b. Das Hinzutreten weltlicher Strafe (s. d. 12) ist bereits so regelmässig, dass es hier ausgeschlossen werden muss
As in Wi 3. Cf. Gl Exkommunikation 8a. b. 11b. The addition of a secular penalty (see ibid. 12) is already so regular that it has to be excluded here

Nicht ‘without expulsion’. Wie reafian neben ‘rauben’ auch ‘richterlich pfänden’ bedeutet (vgl. raf Friesisch ‘Pfändung’), so heisst strudan neben ‘gewaltsam wegnehmen, berauben’ hier ‘konfiszieren’; vgl. Fränkisch strud ‘Pfändung’; Brunner II 453. — Im bisherigen sind bestehende Sexualverhältnisse behandelt, im folgenden neu einzugehende

Not ‘without expulsion’. Just as reafian means, besides ‘rob’, also ‘distrain by judicial authority’ (cf. raf, Frisian ‘distraint’), so strudan, besides ‘take away by force, despoil’, here means ‘confiscate’; cf. Frankish strud ‘distraint’; Brunner II 453. — The preceding provisions deal with existing sexual relationships, those that follow with ones yet to be entered into
